final: SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(*) as num_standings_records, ROUND(COUNT(*) - (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM constructorStandings GROUP BY constructorId)), 1) as diff_from_avg FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
